class.name: JarCapsuleSdf
class.brief_description: A signed distance field (SDF) capsule primitive.
class.description: Represents a capsule (a cylinder with rounded ends) as a signed distance field, defined by two endpoints and a radius. Because the endpoints can be placed freely, no extra transform is needed to orient it — useful for pillars, pipes, or carving rounded tunnels between two points with [JarOperationSdf].

members.member: The first endpoint of the capsule's axis.
The second endpoint of the capsule's axis.
The radius of the capsule around its axis.
